title: West Kelowna Gallery Of Grapes Wine Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum age is 19 years old. Must have valid photo ID
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
Pick up times may vary based on availability and are not guaranteed. Your pick up time will be sent to you upon confirmation of your reservation.
Tastings are included at 5 wineries on this tour. Please note wineries may change due to availability.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: On this West Kelowna wine tour, you will visit some of the best wineries the Okanagan Valley offers, each with award winning wines and breathtaking views of local vineyards and Okanagan Lake. Tour and enjoy wine tastings at 5 wineries on this tour. Wineries on this tour may include: Frind Estate, Rollingdale Winery, Volcanic Hills Winery, Little Straw, Mt. Boucherie, Off The Grid, Grizzli or Indigenous World.
